unsupported: The company was founded in 1988 as the U.S. subsidiary of Japan's Wako Seiki Co., Ltd., a producer of automated assembly equipment.
Ownership remains with the Japanese parent, and no founder names are disclosed in public records.

Wako emphasizes total cost productivity, material quality, and reliability as the foundation of its manufacturing philosophy, aiming to transform into an innovative industry leader that places customer satisfaction at the center.
